metadata.Name: LAMBADA
metadata.Description: LAMBADA is a dataset for evaluating text understanding through word prediction, requiring broad discourse context.
metadata.Paper Title: The LAMBADA dataset: Word prediction requiring a broad discourse context
metadata.Venue Title: 54th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
Affiliations: CIMeC - Center for Mind/Brain Sciences, University of Trento
Institute for Logic, Language & Computation, University of Amsterdam
metadata.Abstract: This paper introduces the LAMBADA dataset, aimed at testing language models on their ability to take a broad discourse context into account when predicting a word. LAMBADA consists of narrative passages where human subjects can guess the last word if they see the whole passage, but not if they only see the last sentence. The dataset is challenging for current language models, and it is proposed as a benchmark to encourage the development of new models capable of genuine understanding of broad context in natural language text.
